title: python-multipart missing from declared deps
body: The multipart/form-data branch of src/umd/api/routers/sources.py ingest_source (lines 210-229) requires python-multipart to parse request.form(), but python-multipart is NOT declared in pyproject.toml [project.dependencies]. In a clean install the multipart feature raises AssertionError("The `python-multipart` library must be installed to use form parsing.") -> 500. I installed python-multipart==0.0.32 into .venv to verify the new multipart tests (test_multipart_upload_ingest_and_job_completes, test_multipart_missing_file_422). This is an implementation/dependency gap (Plan G scope), not a test issue — tests assert correct behavior once the dep is present.

title: Plan M Round-2 coverage gaps filled: 5 hermetic tests
body:
Generated 5 tests in tests/test_semantic_analysis.py covering the three Plan M Round-2 gaps, all hermetic (no Postgres):
- test_observations_evidence_locator_is_content_discriminated (GAP 1 HIGH): content-changing rerun under same SID+digest yields DISTINCT semantic_observations locators (content-hash discriminator), can_auto_promote False.
- test_observations_evidence_locator_stable_on_identical_rerun (GAP 1): identical rerun dedups to SAME locator.
- test_paragraph_segments_strict_zip_raises_on_misalignment (GAP 2): hermetic _Composer over sqlite:// (stores only wrap engine, never queried); fake segment() seam returning empty created/existing + 3 paragraphs raises ValueError "refusing to truncate".
- test_structural_analysis_falls_back_to_chapter1_baseline_on_misalignment (GAP 2): monkeypatched _require_source/_dispatch_text/_evidence drives the strict-zip ValueError -> chapter-1 baseline fallback warning + durable refs + chapter/1/paragraph/N evidence rows.
- test_semantic_prompt_version_and_schema_pin (GAP 3 LOW): SEMANTIC_PROMPT_VERSION == "semantic-analysis@2", per-category fields (observed_state/canonical_name/context_type) and the exact-'segment' rule in the @2 prompt.
Result: 32 passed (18 semantic incl. 5 new + 14 model_provider), ruff clean.
Note: test_production_stage_registry.py is pytest.mark.postgres and its dispatch double has no segment() seam, so the strict-zip ValueError path had zero coverage even in Postgres CI — now covered hermetically here.
